evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel C/C++ API headers, implementation, and example binary (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp).
rationale: Fixes a thread-safety deadlock hazard in libbitcoinkernel callbacks and aligns API semantics with the underlying singleton logger. Holding the internal mutex during callbacks 'serializes all logging threads on user code, and deadlocks if anything on the callback's thread logs, e.g. a garbage collector running finalizers that destroy kernel objects.'
